name: KRC v0.6 — Cardinality-Aware Korean Partitive Reference, Restricted Productive -고 Conjunction & Corpus-Grounded Omission Audit
scientific_target: Build meaning-conditioned Korean writing operations with externally auditable discourse referents, not another proposer/critic approval loop.
data_grounding: Existing NIKL ZA 2020/2025 used for observed omitted arguments and antecedent multiplicity; not as a gold source for 그중 partitive expressions. External Korean coref corpora held separate.
core_objects: Typed plural discourse group with cardinality and nominal kind
Partitive selection of k from n without pretending to identify which exact individual
Complementary remainder with cardinality n-k and provenance
Finite Korean predicate lemma with source-listed tense/polarity and restricted -고 connective
Event chain facts and explicit sequential edge

new_cases: EX18 three books in a reading room
deliverables: Data ledger and hash-only NIKL corpus receipts
At least two source-grounded Korean composed micro-passages

negative_result_clause: If the only available real corpus does not label partitives, record NOT_IDENTIFIED. Do not manufacture gold from zero-anaphora annotation.
